meta.name: food-order
meta.description: Reorder previous Foodora orders, preview cart contents, and track delivery ETA/status with ordercli. Use when the user wants to reorder food, check delivery status, or browse recent Foodora order history. Never confirm an order without explicit user approval.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重新下单外卖并追踪配送状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常点外卖并想快速重复下单
copy.tagline_en: Reorder food and track delivery status
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently order food and want to quickly reorder

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你重新下单 Foodora 历史订单、预览购物车、追踪配送状态。它总是先预览再确认，不会擅自下单。
howto.when: 当你想要重新点餐、查看配送状态或浏览近期 Foodora 订单历史时触发。

say.text: 帮我重新下单上次的 Foodora 订单。
say.note: Claude 会先预览订单内容，等你确认后再下单。

say.text: 查看我最近的 Foodora 订单。
say.note: Claude 会列出最近 10 笔订单。

say.text: 我的 Foodora 订单配送状态如何？
say.note: Claude 会查询当前订单的预计送达时间和状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you reorder previous Foodora orders, preview cart contents, and track delivery status. It always previews first and never confirms without your explicit approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to reorder food, check delivery status, or browse recent Foodora order history.

say_en.note: Claude will preview the order first and ask for confirmation.
Claude will list the last 10 orders.

say_en.text: What's the status of my Foodora delivery?
say_en.note: Claude will check the ETA and status of active orders.
